messages:
nina_sales: Quick sync — AtlasCare requests med-qa-7b-v2 on Private for a 1-month POC. Must support SentencePiece 32k, CMEK (HSM), and int4 quant. They expect interactive p50 <=150ms for single-user UI. Any immediate no-gos?
omar_se: We can host the model but need the exact SentencePiece .model to verify tokenizer id map. Small drift can cause hallucinations in clinical prompts.
leo_infra: Runtime note: int4 + KV cache works on our Blackwell nodes but some attention kernels may still run in fp16; I'll run an int4 vs fp16 canary and perf harness (seq 128/512, conc=1).
nina_sales: They also want a POC quote (infra + 8 support hours). Can you give a rough delta int4 vs fp16 for Dedicated?
leo_infra: Estimated: int4 -> ~35% lower infra cost per token vs fp16 for similar latency, depending on kernel maturity. I'll refine after sweep.
nina_sales: Security Q: can we provide language for their SOC/KMS questionnaire about key rotation and logs?
ashley_security: Draft blurb: "Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys (CMEK) with HSM-backed providers. Customers control rotation schedule; Redwood does not retain plaintext keys. Audit logs for inference and admin actions can be exported to customer SIEM; SOC2 summary available under NDA."
nina_sales: Great. @workflows_bot please open an onboarding ticket and run the compatibility sweep with tokenizer parity, int4 vs fp16, and perf for 128/512 seqs.
workflows_bot: Ticket RINF-9733 opened: "AtlasCare med-qa-7b-v2 POC: tokenizer/quant/KMS validation". Assignee: leo_infra. ETA 72h.
leo_infra: Kicking off tests now. I'll post a short report here with latency numbers and any generation delta flags.
omar_se: I'll prepare a small clinical prompt set and request their SentencePiece files. If mismatch, propose canonical tokenizer export or an fp16 canary.
nina_sales: Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
